About Us

Meet the CEO, ArinCraft World

Salaudeen Oluwafunke Esther is a graduate of Accounting and a creative entrepreneur with a passion for fashion, craftsmanship, and excellence. She is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of ArinCraft World, a distinguished African fashion brand specializing in the design, production, and sale of handmade handbags, clothing, and accessories crafted from carefully selected textiles, leather, and other premium materials.

Driven by a commitment to elegance, quality, and exceptional craftsmanship, she has built ArinCraft World into a brand that embodies sophistication, originality, and timeless style. Her refined personal style and meticulous attention to detail are reflected in every piece created under the brand, offering collections tailored for individuals who appreciate contemporary luxury and enduring elegance.

As a visionary business leader, Salaudeen Oluwafunke Esther continues to drive the growth of ArinCraft World through innovation, professionalism, and purpose-driven entrepreneurship. Her leadership seamlessly combines creativity with strategic business insight, positioning the brand as an emerging and recognizable name in the African luxury fashion and accessories industry.

Beyond her accomplishments as an entrepreneur, she is admired for being approachable, disciplined, and deeply committed to excellence. Doing business with ArinCraft World means partnering with a brand founded on integrity, style, quality, and customer satisfaction.
